children: New pilot pairs professional therapy with everyday journaling under a simple idea: good therapy, good habits.
Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - September 1, 2026) - Everkind Wellness Inc.

(the "Company" or "Everkind"), a wellness platform built for emotional self-care, today announced a 90-day pilot with GoodTherapist, a Canadian platform connecting people with licensed therapists. The collaboration pairs professional care with a private space to reflect between appointments, helping clients carry the work of therapy into everyday life.

Therapy happens in scheduled sessions, but the thinking, feeling, and processing continue in the days between. The collaboration is built around that gap: GoodTherapist connects people with the professional support they need, and Everkind gives them a gentle, private place to journal, reflect, and build healthy habits between sessions. The campaign runs under the theme "good therapy, good habits."

"Everkind was built for the moments between therapy sessions - and this collaboration makes that purpose tangible," said Harrison Newlands, Founder and CEO of Everkind. "When we set out to build Everkind, what was most important was not to use AI to replace the human connection or resources that do exist, but rather help users know where to turn when they need it most. GoodTherapist helps people find the care they need; we help them stay connected to that work every day. Together we're supporting the whole journey, not just the hour on the calendar. This collaboration will help guide users back to real therapists, leveraging their learnings and understandings from the Everkind platform."

"Meaningful progress doesn't happen only during the hour someone spends with their therapist, it continues through the reflection, practice, and small choices made between sessions," said Dr. Pritma Dhillon-Chattha, Co-Founder of GoodTherapist. "We believe technology should strengthen, never replace, the human relationship at the heart of therapy. Everkind gives clients a thoughtful way to stay engaged with what they are learning and bring deeper insight into their next session, making good habits a natural extension of good therapy."
The pilot will launch on September 2nd and run through the first week in December and roll out across both organizations' channels. Everkind is available on the App Store and Google Play.

Everkind is a Toronto-based emotional wellness company making mental and emotional support accessible, affordable, and stigma-free. Its platform combines AI-powered journaling and personalized meditations, acting as an intelligent companion that learns and adapts with each user, grounded in evidence-based practices and built for daily habit formation. Private, non-clinical, and designed for real life. Learn more at

GoodTherapist is a Canadian online therapy platform making it easier for people to find and connect with a licensed therapist who fits their needs, preferences, and goals. Offering virtual individual and couples therapy across Canada, GoodTherapist combines personalized matching, convenient online care, and a diverse network of experienced and vetted therapists to help more people access high-quality mental health support.
